how_sent: Zero-shot. baselines/llm/prompt.txt was the whole instruction. baselines/llm/items.jsonl held 50 test conversations and no labels. The model read those two files in one pass and wrote baselines/llm/predictions.csv. No labeled conversation was included in the prompt.
leaderboard: Scored on 50 of 88 test conversations. This file is not a full-test leaderboard submission.
